reason: I'd take the free first visit to look, but $16 every Saturday adds up when the zoo is free and I only get weekends. I wouldn't be paying for it regularly.
objection: Weekends are when it's busiest, so will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The Baby Nook helps, but $16 on a Saturday for something I can swap for a free zoo trip is hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to $10, or seeing on a Saturday that the cap on kids really keeps it calm and the Baby Nook is actually separate from the big kids.
